docs.purpose: Returns the fixed list of construction product and material categories the app uses to classify permits, for populating a filter dropdown. No user data or database is involved.
docs.data_story: It touches no table at all. Its response shape is **unmeasured** as a pick-by-name whitelist — it passes rows through, spreads a row into a computed object, or assembles the payload dynamically, so there is no single list naming what leaves the server. **Nothing in this repository calls it.** That is the state this registry exists to make visible, not a claim that it is dead — a caller could be a bookmark, an external system, or a path built from variables.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `QUERY`. It declares its `database.reads[]` with named columns, its response projection as an explicit whitelist, its auth class, its rate bucket and its staleness — and `outputs.writes` is forced to `"none"`. Its `consumers[]` is the field that matters most here: today it is empty, and the orphan panel renders that as a red row rather than leaving it to be discovered years later.

notes: A 7-line static stub: returns the hardcoded PRODUCT_GROUPS constant from src/lib/classification/products wrapped in withApiEnvelope. No DB access, no auth check. No in-repo caller found. | MEASURED 2026-09-15: NO DATABASE ACCESS. PRODUCT_GROUPS is a hardcoded module-level constant (src/lib/classification/products.ts:9-37) — 27 entries, 20 'material' / 4 'rental' / 3 'service'. This is the ONE route in this group where the empty `reads` list means 'I read every line of the route and its single import and there is no query call', not 'I did not look'. CHECKLIST agreement: routes-index.json lists census_reads [] and census_writes [] for /api/products — confirmed. Unauthenticated caller receives: a static taxonomy of product-group ids, slugs, display names, sort orders and types. No personal data, no valuations, no coordinates — NOT a disclosure finding. The only observation worth recording is that the response is {products: [...]} rather than the {data,error,meta} envelope the wrapper advertises (src/lib/api/with-api-envelope.ts:5-9), so a client that unwraps `.data` gets undefined on success and a populated `.error` only on the (unreachable) failure path. | Caching: none observed — no revalidate/dynamic export and no Cache-Control header in src/app/api/products/route.ts:1-7 (the payload is a module constant, so Next.js may still statically optimize it, but nothing in the file declares that) | Other guards / classification: PUBLIC: '/api/products' is in PUBLIC_PREFIXES (src/lib/auth/route-guard.ts:71), matched at route-guard.ts:170 -> 'public'; middleware pass-through src/middleware.ts:43-45 | ORPHAN — zero call sites in src/** or mobile/** (sweep 2026-09-15, comment lines stripped). | No test file under src/tests/** imports this route.
